suggestions.title: The Departed
suggestions.description: An undercover cop and a mole in the police force try to uncover each other's identities within the Boston mob — Scorsese's Oscar-winning crime masterpiece with DiCaprio, Damon, and Nicholson.

suggestions.title: The Silence of the Lambs
suggestions.description: An FBI trainee seeks the insight of imprisoned cannibalistic serial killer Dr. Hannibal Lecter to catch another killer — a chilling, Oscar-sweeping psychological thriller.

suggestions.title: City of God
suggestions.description: Two boys growing up in a violent Rio de Janeiro favela take different paths — one becomes a photographer, the other a drug dealer — in this breathtaking, kinetic Brazilian masterpiece.
